item.title: Gumby Jams with the Iconic Band RUSH!
item.description: The iconic Canadian band RUSH has a new documentary "Time Stand Still." As Gumby fans, they included a segment of Gumby and pals rocking out to their music.

item.title: Meet Gumby's Godfather Tom Sarnoff
item.description: Tom Sarnoff greenlit the first Gumby Show on NBC in '56, and he's been involved with Gumby ever since. Here's an exclusive interview with Gumby's Godfather.

item.title: Here Comes Gumby in the Hollywood Christmas Parade
item.description: Catch Gumby in the Hollywood Christmas Parade, November 27. TV airings on the CW, Hallmark Channel, Armed Forces Network, and others during the season.

item.title: Dynamite Entertainment to Release Retrospective Art Book of a True American Icon: Gumby
item.description: Get a glimpse of the rich and fascinating history of Gumby and creator Art Clokey in this ultimate retrospective biography written by the Clokey family.

item.title: Gumby to Star in New Comics Series
item.description: Leading comics publisher Papercutz develops new monthly comic books and kids’ graphic novels featuring the iconic clay stop-motion animated character Gumby.

item.title: Gumby Imagined - The Ultimate Gumby Retrospective - Now Available!
item.description: Gumby Imagined, Story of Art Clokey and His Creations is in bookstores now. This ultimate retrospective is packed with incredible photos and stories.

item.title: Gumby Appears in New Comics and Graphic Novel
item.description: A brand new series of Gumby comic books and a graphic novel launched in 2017, featuring uniquely Gumby adventures developed by an all-star creative team.

item.title: Gumby is Now Streaming on Amazon Prime
item.description: Enjoy all of the great, remastered Gumby episodes from the 1950s, 1960s and The Gumby Movie on Amazon Prime. Share, bring back memories and create new ones.

item.title: Gumby Showcased in New Traveling Animation Exhibit
item.description: “Get Animated!” explores the history of animation from pencils to pixels. It features Gumby puppets, sets, props, stop-motion studio and info on Art Clokey.

item.title: Exclusive 3D Printed Gumby Figures Now Available
item.description: New limited edition Gumby collectibles now available. Customize the style, pose, size, and base to personalize. Endless variations with 3D print technology.
